Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state

Record Class AppearanceOverride

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.AppearanceOverride
public record AppearanceOverride(Optional<EyeColor> cornea, Optional<EyeColor> iris, Optional<Boolean> glow) extends Record
A sparse override of an eye's EyeAppearance: each field is optional and, when absent, falls back to the underlying value (a mob's datapack appearance, via EyeAppearance.overlay(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.AppearanceOverride)).

This is the one portable appearance payload. Persistent forms use CODEC; the bounded network packet (EyeStatePacket) uses STREAM_CODEC. It serves three uses:

  • an eye item's data component (what survives crafting / harvest),
  • a mob's per-entity override (see EyeState),
  • the network sync payload (EyeStatePacket).

Appearance only. Placement — position, scale, angles, attach part — is never here; it always comes from the mob's datapack config (EyePlacement). An eye item carries "what the eye looks like", and attaching it reuses that mob's configured placement.

Behaviors (stare, blink, swirl, …) are transient triggered effects, not appearance; they have no presence here (see EyeBehavior).
